stated_limitation: individual place cells showed variable and often statistically weak single-cell relationships (a known feature of real data with limited per-cell sampling — tens to a few hundred field-crossing spikes over 20-40 laps)

justification.dataset: Canonical Grosmark & Buzsaki CA1 linear-track dataset, correct subject/session for theta entrainment and precession.
justification.handling: Real streamed NWB data with correct epoch restriction, explicit unit selection, and careful handling of SWR contamination and an NWB rate-attribute quirk.
justification.analysis: Correct circular statistics with a permutation control, but the pooled precession test ignores cell identity (pseudoreplication) that a per-cell shuffle would have addressed.
justification.correctness: Reported values reproduce and are internally consistent, though the pooled p-value is anticonservative while the negative slope direction remains robust.
justification.figures: Entrainment and population precession effects are visible and labeled with units, n, and stats; the pooled scatter is noisy but the negative trend is real.
justification.honesty: No fabrication and single-cell weakness plus single-session limits are stated plainly, but 'clear, highly significant' overstates a weak rho=0.14 and the pseudoreplication caveat is omitted.
justification.verdict: Sound, honest core work with a real but fixable statistical weakness in the pooled test — accept with revision.
